name: personal-tax
description: Builds and reviews individual income tax computations under the Income Tax Act 1967 — resident scale vs non-resident treatment, employment income (s.13 salary, BIK, perquisites, ESOS, gratuity), personal reliefs and rebates, the self-assessment return (Form BE / Form B), and filing and instalment deadlines — every figure traced to a source document (EA form, statements) and tied back to the computation, every rate, relief, and threshold flagged for verification against current LHDN guidance.
